thread:
Maria Chen: Kicking off a small canary for runtime v2026.03.21 (model-serving v2.3.2) -> start at 5% in eu-west during change window now. DeployBot will post progress. Please watch p95 and kv cache miss rate. @Trent O'Neil @Li Wang
DeployBot: Scheduled rollout started — canary id c-8912 — target: 5% eu-west. Revision v2.3.2. Logs: https://internal/logs/c-8912
Trent O'Neil: seeing a p95 blip on a subset of hosts ~2m after cutover, digging in
Maria Chen: can you paste numbers? if p95 > 500ms for 2 samples we'll hold
Trent O'Neil: ```p95 baseline ~120ms -> observed 540ms on host i-abc123
kv_cache_miss_rate: baseline 2% -> 18% on that host
errors: small increase (auth timeouts)```
Li Wang: 18% miss rate is high — sounds like cache warmup or wrong TTL. If warmup fail, we should pin traffic back to v2.3.1 for affected clusters. Sam, can you run a pin for cluster-a?
Sam Ortiz: running `/deploy pin --service=runtime-eu-west --version=v2.3.1 --scope=cluster-a` now
DeployBot: Command accepted. Pinning traffic for cluster-a to v2.3.1. Canary traffic now ~2% (cluster-a pinned).
Maria Chen: Hold. No further ramp until infra confirms K/V warmup. @ops-bot collect heap/evict stats for cluster-a please
ops-bot: collecting histograms, returning short summary: cache_evicts/sec up 4x; resident_set trending +15% on affected host set
Trent O'Neil: found mis-sized cache TTL in new runtime config (bad default). Pushing patch to set TTL=60s -> ETA ~12m to build and push. Recommend hold and rollback option if not fixed quickly
Li Wang: +1 for patch+retest if warmup looks trivial. But want quick vote from ops — we shouldn't risk user latency.
Sam Ortiz: I vote rollback for cluster-a until patch is verified. quick vote: +1 rollback
Li Wang: vote +1 rollforward-with-patch
Maria Chen: tally: rollback=Sam, rollforward=Li. I'm calling a conservative route: hold rollout and keep cluster-a pinned to v2.3.1. Sam, please perform rollback on cluster-a if pin didn't fully shift traffic yet and confirm when done.
Sam Ortiz: rollback initiated for cluster-a -> v2.3.1. Monitoring.
DeployBot: Rollback completed for cluster-a -> v2.3.1. Post-rollback metrics: p95 back to baseline (~130ms), kv_cache_miss_rate back to ~2%. Canary suspended on that cluster.
Maria Chen: Thanks — good catch. We'll keep the overall rollout paused for eu-west. Trent, work with Li on the config patch; reopen thread when patched and warmup validated. I'll create a short follow-up note for release notes and incident log. :thumbsup:
